method.method_draft: Read the diagram as triangle ABC with D and E on base BC, AD drawn from A to D, and AE drawn from A to E inside the triangle. From the text, use AD ⟂ BC, angle B = 70°, angle C = 30°, and AE bisects angle BAC. Because AD is perpendicular to BC, triangles ABD and ADC are right triangles. In right triangle ABD, angle BAD = 90° - angle B = 20°. In right triangle ADC, angle DAC = 90° - angle C = 60°. Therefore angle BAC = angle BAD + angle DAC = 20° + 60° = 80°. Since AE bisects angle BAC, angle BAE = 80°/2 = 40°.
